items.exampleEn: He quit his job last month.
Be careful not to spill your coffee.
My dad keeps a tool kit in his car.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸在車上放了一套工具。

items.exampleEn: My parents forbid me to stay out late.
items.exampleZh: 我爸媽禁止我在外面待到很晚。

items.exampleEn: The phone is a great invention.
items.exampleZh: 電話是一項偉大的發明。
這家旅館提供免費早餐。

items.sentenceEn: Please don't spill water on the floor.

items.audioEn: Our teacher provided us with a map before the trip.
items.audioZh: 出發前，老師給了我們一張地圖。
items.questionZh: 出發前老師提供了什麼？

items.sentenceEn: It seems that nobody is at home.
My father quit smoking ten years ago.
items.sentenceZh: 我爸爸十年前就戒菸了。

items.stemEn: I think I ____ my phone on the train.
items.stemZh: 我好像把手機掉在火車上了。
這棟建築物裡禁止吸菸。

items.passageEn: My grandfather loves new inventions. Last month, he bought a coffee machine. It seems easy to use, and it provides hot coffee in one minute. But on the first day, he spilled coffee all over the kitchen. Now my grandmother forbids him to use it alone! He almost quit, but my brother gave him a cleaning kit and showed him how to use the machine.
items.passageZh: 我爺爺很喜歡新發明。上個月，他買了一台咖啡機。它看起來很好用，一分鐘就能煮好熱咖啡。可是第一天，他就把咖啡灑得整個廚房都是。現在我奶奶禁止他一個人使用！他差點就放棄了，不過我哥哥給了他一組清潔用具，還教他怎麼用那台咖啡機。

questions.questionZh: 爺爺第一天用咖啡機時發生了什麼事？
options: 把咖啡灑得整個廚房都是

questions.questionZh: 奶奶現在禁止爺爺做什麼？
options: 自己再去店裡買新東西

items.promptZh: 他好像很喜歡他的新工作。
referenceEn: He seems to like his new job.
He seems to really like his new job.
rubricZh: seem 後面可接 to＋原形動詞或形容詞（例如 seems to like）；寫 It seems that he likes… 也正確
主詞是第三人稱單數，動詞要加 s（例如 seems）

items.promptZh: 我昨天在公車上弄丟了雨傘。
referenceEn: I lost my umbrella on the bus yesterday.
Yesterday I lost my umbrella on the bus.
rubricZh: 昨天的事用過去式（例如 lost）
「在公車上」可寫，例如 on the bus 等
yesterday 放句首或句尾都可以
